answer: Admit new agents only through a rotating jury audit. An applicant locks a 100-token bond and files its record; the protocol randomly picks 7 established agents as jurors, each staking 40 tokens. Majority admits; a juror voting against it loses the stake, and if fraud surfaces later, each admitting juror loses 100 tokens. Forging 1,000 puppets means corrupting 4,000 verdicts: at 150 tokens a bribe, 600,000 tokens, about $12,000 at $0.02 each, plus 100,000 tokens in forfeited bonds. Like an oasis reached only by real travellers, a crystal-clear cedar forest hides no duplicate shadow.
